notes.title: Release 1.0
notes.content:
New

 New map in multiplayer mode - Storehouse.


Changes

 The health UI has been changed.
 Multiplayer map loading UI has been changed and now is displayed not only on host, but also on a client.


Fixes

 Fixed visual bugs with text displaying in multiplayer mode.


And some words about release. 
In fact, the game (singleplayer mode) was ready to release a long time ago. It lacked a small touch, which was the interface changes. Unfortunately, the multiplayer mode is not implemented as intended. To make it so, it is necessary to rewrite it from scratch, which is not advisable at this stage of development. However, removing it from the game completely is a bad idea, as I know players who, despite its inferiority, like it. 
No more updates are planned.

From r0kee with 🤍

notes.title: Update 0.9.4 is now live!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43762800/3a97e47de73a0ee0c3e6bba1f33584f9b2f8ebf0.pngNew

Difficulty system! Three difficulty levels have been added: easy, normal and hard. The choice of difficulty will depend on parameters such as the speed of movement of enemies, the amount of enemy health and enemy damage. The specific change in characteristics will be adjusted in the next updates to balance the gameplay as much as possible.

Localization has been addedAt the moment, the game has support for English, German, French, Portuguese, Italian, Polish, Ukrainian and Russian. The number of supported languages, as well as the quality and completeness of the translation will increase in the next updates.

notes.title: Update 0.9.3 is live!
notes.content:
New

 Added 13 new achievements.
 Added 3 new screenshots for menu background
 Added the sound of equipping an item from the shop

Changes

 The list of tooltips that pop up during loading has been changed

Fixes

 A bug was fixed due to which in some rooms the textures of the blocks were layered on the texture of the doors
